Ran a divisor sweep (1.00-1.40) looking for a clean delivery-platform markup factor to back out; none found (raw/undivided prices already sit predominantly on clean .00/.25/.50/.75 cent endings, no single divisor produced a notably better fit) - filed as-is at medium confidence since these are Uber Eats delivery prices (may include a modest platform markup vs in-restaurant price) with no independent first-party price list to cross-check against.

name: Copa Vida - East Village
not_found: Independently confirmed closed. Yelp listing for this address (905 J St, San Diego, CA 92101) is marked 'COPA VIDA - CLOSED'. sandiegoville.com published an article (Sept 12, 2025) titled 'Copa Vida Shutters East Village San Diego Cafe After A [10-Year Run]' confirming the closure of the East Village cafe. An Instagram post also announced 'We're saying farewell to our East Village location on Friday, August 29th.' Copa Vida still operates other locations (Torrey Ridge, Pasadena, Glendale) but this specific East Village location is permanently closed -> not_found.
